name: United Korea
concept: Peaceful or forced reunification of the Korean peninsula under one government.

name: Gran Colombia
concept: Revival of Bolívar's republic uniting the northern Andes and the isthmus.

name: European Federation
concept: The EU turned into a single federal state with a common government, army and foreign policy.

name: Nordic Union
concept: A federation of the Nordic countries sharing defence, currency and foreign policy.

name: Maghreb Union
concept: A political union of North Africa's western Arab states, reviving the Arab Maghreb Union.

name: Greater Somalia
concept: Unification of the Somali-inhabited lands of the Horn of Africa.

name: East African Federation
concept: The long-planned political federation of the East African Community.

name: Union of South American Nations
concept: A continental union of South America with a common market, parliament and currency.

name: Pan-Arab Federation
concept: A unified Arab state from the Atlantic to the Gulf.

name: Central Asian Union
concept: Integration of the five Central Asian republics into a single union.

name: Benelux Union
concept: Full political union of Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg.

name: Federation of Indochina
concept: A federation of the former French Indochina states.

name: Iberian Union
concept: Union of Spain and Portugal under a shared state.

name: Balkan Federation
concept: A federation of the western and southern Balkan states overcoming old rivalries.

name: Baltic Union
concept: A federal union of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania.

name: Turkic Union
concept: A confederation of Turkic states building on the Organization of Turkic States.

name: Greater Romania
concept: Reunification of Romania and Moldova.

name: United Ireland
concept: Irish reunification through a border poll in Northern Ireland.

name: Reunified Cyprus
concept: A bizonal, bicommunal federation ending the island's division.

name: Central American Federation
concept: Revival of the 19th-century Federal Republic of Central America.
